scope: Read-only source audit. No live API, credential access, deployed change or model-selection authorization.
portability_state: Core business flow reusable; another provider is not currently plug-compatible.

coupling.finding: Astra/max profile, OpenAI Responses endpoint/wire format, response ID/status/output/usage parser, and result metadata are fixed.
Worker calls model build_request before reservation, accepts only Astra/max, loads only OpenAI key, reserves fixed 2 USD for openai, and reports hardcoded model metadata.
Ledger supports only google_cloud/openai/visual_generation; success/failure receipts and recovery enforce openai, Astra/max, OpenAI response IDs and usage shape.
Secrets and IAM provisioning authorize one OpenAI secret, with no alternative provider credential.

Requests transport has no OpenAI SDK requirement. Container/source package is portable as code, but new modules must be explicitly included in package allowlist. Firestore/Cloud Run hosting remains Google-specific.

minimal_changes.change: Separate domain input/output schema validation from provider transport/parser. Define validated ModelResult and ModelFailure contracts; keep authority and dispatch outside model.

Add immutable allowlisted model profiles and deterministic routing policy with enabled=false for new hybrid route. Persist provider/model/effort/policy version/limits/route reason before budget reservation; bind result to that selection. Default remains accepted Astra/max.

Pass selected profile through request builder, worker envelope, normalized receipt, and ledger. Preserve old Astra receipt schema/records. Reconcile actual model usage separately from conservative profile-specific reservation; price snapshot is not invoice.

Permit one explicit planned escalation after a completed low-confidence routine analysis only within a preauthorized two-stage budget and immutable attempt lineage; no automatic provider/model fallback for unknown, incomplete, failed or refused calls. Multi-model analysis still yields one business proposal and one action identity.

Add offline contract/routing/migration tests, adversarial scope/escalation examples, and paired quality acceptance cases. Update strict deployment file allowlist. No activation before chosen model, account access, bounded live eval and valid spend/operational authority.

activation_blockers: User selection of economical routine model/profile and permitted escalation route
Routine-model live access and task-specific quality acceptance not yet demonstrated
Ongoing budget beyond 2026-10-12 is not authorized
Autonomous customer scope, verified brand/service/contacts/project mapping and unseen CC-removal/delayed-action control remain separate unmet requirements

required: Explicit provider/account and customer-data destination authorization
Separate secret/IAM allowlist and provider ledger migration
Equivalent acceptance checks; reuse Gmail/Basecamp/core rather than rebuilding

evidence_cautions: Existing source package is credential-free but is not a proven Claude connector.
Changing MODEL alone fails current worker/store guards.
README-model.txt still says 8192 output tokens while live source model.py uses 16384; source is current.
No public pricing or supported effort-level claim was independently verified by this local audit.
